shortDescription: Uploads files to Cisco FTD devices over HTTP(S)

options.name: file_to_upload
options.description: Absolute path to the file that should be uploaded.

options.name: operation
options.description: The name of the operation to execute. Only operations that upload file can be used in this module.

options.name: register_as
options.description: Specifies Ansible fact name that is used to register received response from the FTD device.
